assessments.reasoning: The Wget 1.25.0 manual identifies a startup notation and describes variable assignments whose allowed value forms depend on the command.

challenge.method: Compare the startup-file syntax with the following legal-value classes and the captured curl option-file specification.
challenge.results: The manual enumerates Boolean, string, and numeric forms for commands. The cURL manual expresses its separate CLI-argument interpretation. A shared classifier group supplies no common parser contract.

limitations: The claim identifies the documented GNU Wget startup notation. Tool execution was outside the review.
